hypotheses.title: Dip-Adaptive Salem Tilt-Contact Pullback x Steerable 8-Azimuth Log-Cauchy Step-vs-Dike Symmetry + Fold-Safe Basement Mass-Balance Residual (BMR) & Up-Head Geothermal Conduit Discovery
layers: depth_to_base_surf (Band 15, inside fold-safe BMR forward residual & local cot(delta) pullback displacement only)

Official SHA-256-pinned USGS 3DEP 1m LiDAR scarp rasters (10m DEM quantile-debiased), 10m DEM drainage-divide chi jump, GeoDAWN seam-vetoed K/eTh & U/eTh, DOE GDR #1391 well/spring Fournier thermal disequilibrium (dist_known_fault_px banned), 3,800 2m temperature probes, and 726 paleo-geothermal sinter/travertine/opaline vents
hypotheses.signature: Four coupled physical operators evaluated before dot placement: (1) Local Dip-Adaptive Salem Tilt-Contact Migration cot_hat(delta)(x,y) in [0.0, 0.85] estimated from the cross-strike lateral displacement between FFT upward-continued tilt zero-level sets at z1=200 m and z2=1,000 m, driving bilinear hanging-wall up-dip pullback Delta_s(x,y) = clip((Z_b/100)*cot_hat(delta), 0, 14 px) so moderately dipping Basin-and-Range normal faults shift updip onto surface emergence while subvertical (80-90 deg) Walker Lane strike-slip faults undergo near-zero shift; (2) Steerable 8-azimuth log-Cauchy odd-step minus even-dike quadrature phase symmetry (|O_m| - |E_m|) coupled with Garland (1951) Poisson magnetization-to-density admittance jump to suppress symmetric volcanic dikes and sill edges; (3) Fold-safe out-of-quadrant Parker-Bouguer Basement-Interface Forward-Gravity Mass-Balance Residual S_BMR^(-q) = ||grad_h(B13 - g_hat_base^(-q)(B15))|| isolating unmodeled intrabasin horst steps and hydrothermal silica/calcite densification; and (4) Up-hydraulic-head advected GDR-1391 Fournier thermal disequilibrium + 2m probe walls + sinter vents fused via 5-fold (80/20 hide-matched) strict Leave-One-Quadrant-Out cover-conditioned Noisy-OR and Exact 6-Ring Bernoulli Survival Dinkelbach-CELF.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: USGS/INGENIOUS surface mapping omits (a) blind range-front and intrabasin synthetic/antithetic normal faults buried under 200-2,000 m of Cenozoic valley fill whose gravity/magnetic contacts lie 300-1,200 m down-dip of surface emergence, (b) concealed transtensional Walker Lane strike-slip stepovers where constant 60 deg pullback mis-shifts subvertical faults off-trace, and (c) zero-relief hydrothermal upflow conduits marked only by basement mass-excess densification, Fournier silica over-temperature, and 2m thermal walls.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: H86K-STDP hardcoded a uniform 60 deg (cot 60 = 0.577) pullback across the entire Great Basin (degrading subvertical Walker Lane Fold SW), lacked directional odd-vs-even dike quadrature veto, omitted the fold-safe BMR basement forward-gravity residual (followup_hypotheses_20261025.json Rank 1), and trained cross-component elastic fields on 50%-visible splits (mismatching the 80%-visible holdout distribution). H86J-MCSP used isotropic Riesz monogenic phase without dip-adaptive pullback or BMR. GEMSDOE92 used 1D uncoupled listric crest offsets (0.0255). No prior lane combines local cot_hat(delta) Salem tilt migration, 8-azimuth log-Cauchy dike veto, fold-safe BMR, and 80/20 hide-matched LOQO.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Asymmetric Miocene basaltic-andesite lava-flow margins, buried pluton-wallroof contacts, laterally variable Quaternary fanglomerate compaction density gradients, and topographically driven non-fault warm groundwater seepage toes.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Highest (+0.012 to +0.028 HOLDOUT-DTI over H86K-STDP 0.1380 and pixel-local E3 control; maintains >0.110 off-catalogue SGMC-PROXY-DTI while fixing Fold SW strike-slip over-pullback)
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~450 LOC in src/gems86_slcq/ + ~12-15 min total CPU runtime for 3 preregistered arms on strict 4-fold LOQO)

hypotheses.title: Analytical 2-D Cauchy Fault-Step vs 3-D Compact-Pluton Source-Shape Likelihood Ratio Across Upward-Continuation Scales
hypotheses.signature: Fits the log-amplitude attenuation slope d log ||grad_h U(x,y;z)|| / d log(z + z0) across four FFT upward-continuation altitudes z in {100, 300, 700, 1500} m jointly with cross-strike Cauchy half-width scaling w(z) = z0 + z, computing the analytical Bayes factor favoring a 2-D semi-infinite faulted slab (structural index N = 0 to 0.5 in horizontal gradient) over a 3-D equant intrusion or caldera plug (N = 2 to 3).
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Concealed range-bounding and intrabasin basement steps beneath thick pediment gravel have zero surface scarp and smooth kilometer-scale gravity gradients missed by air-photo fault mappers, yet exhibit long-strike 2-D structural-index persistence (N ~ 0.5) distinct from compact plutons.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: H86B-GFCO used raw tilt ridges without structural-index decay-exponent fitting; H86E-MMT used uncalibrated multiscale tilt products; GSST in followup_hypotheses_20261025.json has never been implemented or run.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Linear paleo-erosional bedrock valley walls, elongate Mesozoic batholith margins, and regional Moho/mid-crustal density ramps.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Moderate (+0.005 to +0.014 HOLDOUT-DTI when paired with submodular spacing; lower precision than H86M-SLCQ within +/-300 m kernel without dip-adaptive pullback)
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (~180 LOC FFT multi-altitude structural-index regression, ~4 min CPU)

hypotheses.title: Persistent 0-D Conductive-Gouge Saddle-Neck Topology Conditioned on Transtensional Dilatation & Seismicity Concordance
hypotheses.signature: Computes upper-level-set persistent homology 0-D merge-saddle necks on locally baseline-detrended log(1 + cond_surf) strictly where aspect-ratio eccentricity > 3.5 and positive dilatation/shear strain rate (geod_dilaterate > 0, geod_shearrate) co-occur with elevated microseismic density (ieq_n100a15, deq_n100a15), extracting narrow smectite/illite-altered fluid-flow bridges across relay ramps while zeroing low-eccentricity conductive basins.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Active geothermal upflow in stepovers (e.g., Bradys, Desert Peak, Dixie Valley blind relays) occurs along clay-altered, fluid-saturated damage-zone necks buried under flat playa evaporites that erase surface fault scarps.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: H86K-PSC computed persistent saddles on potential-field gradients (gravity/magnetic) rather than MT/EM electrical conductivity + geodetic dilatation; GDSC used pixelwise strain products without topological saddle-neck persistence; CNT in followup_hypotheses_20261025.json remains unimplemented.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Elongate Pleistocene pluvial lake-margin evaporite/brine strands, conductive graphitic/sulfidic Paleozoic black shales (Roberts Mountains allochthon), and regional GPS smoothing lobes.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Low-to-moderate (+0.002 to +0.008 HOLDOUT-DTI standalone because Band 17 cond_surf and Bands 4/7/8 geodetic strain have >1-5 km native smoothness relative to the 300 m DTI kernel)
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-Medium (~220 LOC union-find watershed saddle persistence, ~3 min CPU)

hypotheses.title: OPERA Sentinel-1 Vertical/LOS Aseismic Fault-Creep Step x USGS ASTER SWIR Al-OH/Opaline Hydrothermal Clay Alteration
layers: External: NASA JPL / ASF DAAC OPERA Level-3 Surface Displacement from Sentinel-1 (OPERA_L3_DISP-S1_V1, 30 m)
External: USGS EROS / ScienceBase ASTER Global Emissivity & SWIR Mineral Index Maps (DOI 10.5066/P9BA3684, Al-OH 2.20 um, Kaolinite/Alunite/Chalcedony)
hypotheses.signature: Cross-strike 300 m step discontinuity in multi-year InSAR line-of-sight velocity residual (after removing long-wavelength GNSS strain Bands 7-8 and groundwater-pumping bowls) colocalized with narrow ASTER SWIR Al-OH / opaline silica argillic alteration corridors.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Aseismically creeping blind faults and active steam-heated acid-sulfate / argillic alteration haloes in sagebrush pediments lack >1 m Quaternary scarps required for USGS Qfaults compilation.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: No GEMSDOE86 lane has ingested satellite InSAR velocity fields or spaceborne SWIR clay-mineral spectroscopy; GeoDAWN provides gamma-ray K/U/Th radiometrics rather than 2.1-2.4 um phyllosilicate absorption.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Agricultural/mining groundwater subsidence margins (e.g., Humboldt River / Fallon bowls), playa seasonal evaporite heave, and stratabound hydrothermally altered volcanic tuffs.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Potentially high (+0.015 to +0.030 DTI) on unrestricted workstation, 0.000 in current sandbox due to egress allowlist
hypotheses.implementation_cost: High external ingestion (~20-60 GB Sentinel-1 OPERA tiles + ASTER mosaic)
